Regulation: B.C. Reg. 108/2026
Made under: Employment And Assistance Act
Published in: No. 12 – B.C. Regs. 99 to 109, June 30, 2026
Deposit date: June 26, 2026

B.C. Reg. 108/2026, deposited June 26, 2026, under theEMPLOYMENT AND ASSISTANCE ACT[section 35] andEMPLOYMENT AND ASSISTANCE FOR PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES ACT[section 26]. Order in Council 268/2026, approved and ordered June 26, 2026. On the recommendation of the undersigned, the Lieutenant Governor, by and with the advice and consent of the Executive Council, orders that (a)	effective July 1, 2026, the Employment and Assistance Regulation, B.C. Reg. 263/2002, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule 1, (b)	effective July 1, 2026, the Employment and Assistance for Persons with Disabilities Regulation, B.C. Reg. 265/2002, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule 2, (c)	effective August 1, 2026, the Employment and Assistance Regulation is amended as set out in the attached Schedule 3, (d)	effective August 1, 2026, the Employment and Assistance for Persons with Disabilities Regulation is amended as set out in the attached Schedule 4, (e)	effective April 1, 2027, the Employment and Assistance Regulation is amended as set out in the attached Schedule 5, and (f)	effective April 1, 2027, the Employment and Assistance for Persons with Disabilities Regulation is amended as set out in the attached Schedule 6. — S. minutes_briefs.title: BC Children and Youth Disability Benefit payments exempt from income for assistance programs
minutes_briefs.summary: British Columbia has amended its Employment and Assistance regulations so that payments from the new BC Children and Youth Disability Benefit will not be counted as income when calculating eligibility for income assistance or disability assistance. This means families receiving this benefit will not see their other assistance payments reduced because of it. The change applies to both the main Employment and Assistance Regulation and the separate regulation for persons with disabilities, with different parts taking effect on July 1, 2026, August 1, 2026, and April 1, 2027.
minutes_briefs.action_required: If you administer income assistance or disability assistance, update your income calculation procedures to exclude BC Children and Youth Disability Benefit payments as of the effective dates.
